notes.title: Heads up: The game is going paid next week
notes.notes:
⚠️ Heads up: The game is going paid next week

Hey everyone,

We’ve got an important update from the team at PAGA GAMES.

Our game has been free to play — and that’s been intentional. We wanted as many of you as possible to try it out, send us feedback, and help shape what it’s become.

But next week, that’s changing:
The game will no longer be free.

We’re switching to a paid model so we can keep improving and supporting it long-term. It’s a big step for us as an indie team.

What this means for you:
	•	If you’ve already downloaded the game — it’s yours to keep, forever, no charge.
	•	If you haven’t tried it yet — now’s the time. You’ve got one week to grab it for free.

Thanks for being here, playing, testing, and sticking with us.
We seriously appreciate you.

— The PAGA GAMES team

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News from PAGA GAMES! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!

We are thrilled to announce the launch of our latest adventure - Dark Riddle, now available on Steam! 🚀

Dark Riddle is a game that promises to immerse you in a world of intrigue, mystery, and thrilling puzzles. As the creators at PAGA GAMES, we've worked tirelessly to bring you a unique experience that combines challenging gameplay with a captivating storyline.

What to Expect:

🧩 Engaging Puzzles: Each level is packed with clever challenges that will test your problem-solving skills.
🕵️ Intriguing Storyline: Dive into a narrative that’s as mysterious as it is compelling.
🌃 Stunning Graphics: Explore beautifully designed environments that are as dark as they are mesmerizing.
🎵 Immersive Soundtrack: A hauntingly beautiful soundtrack that enhances the game's eerie atmosphere.
Join the Adventure:
Dark Riddle is more than just a game; it's an experience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the world of video games, we're confident you'll find something to love in this dark and twisted adventure.

Support and Community:
We at PAGA GAMES are committed to providing an exceptional gaming experience. If you have any questions, suggestions, or just want to share your experience, join our community or reach out to us. Your feedback is invaluable!

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to hear what you think about Dark Riddle. Let the games begin! 🎮

Best regards,
The PAGA GAMES Team
